note: Wooded campground and cabin resort east of Shelbyville, 2.5 miles from Lake Shelbyville, with a pool and a 2.5-acre fishing pond (catch and release, no swimming or boats). Mostly seasonal: most sites are permanent seasonal sites, with a block of drive-through and overnight sites kept for nightly guests. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 250 sites (200 permanent seasonal, 20 drive-through, 30 overnight); W/E $35, FHU $40, +$3 50 A (rates page Last-Modified 2026-07-12) - stored $35-43 confirmed; holiday 3-night minimum and +$10; extra person $6 past 2 adults + 3 children; booking by e-mailed form/phone; hookups 50/water/sewer, dump, showers, laundry, store, wifi confirmed; count 200 -> 250. Google 4.1/163. Pin ~520 m off (at the IL-16 entrance). Mostly seasonal but 20% nightly: passes the five tests with a seasonal caveat in the note.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): cheapest RV night $35 (Water & Electric; full hookup $40; +$3 for 50 A; holiday weekends +$10 and 3-night minimum), operator rates page with no year printed, server Last-Modified 2026-07-12. Under $50. Not a Good Sam Park (stored good_sam false, derived). No gateway within 40 km (Gateway Arch NP 152 km).
GOOGLE: 'Robin Hood Woods Campground & Resort' 4.1 over 163 reviews (read 2026-11-12). RV Life 5* $$ stored. Over 4.0: no review drop.
PRESENCE: working operator site with phone (217) 774-4222 (matches stored) and an e-mailed reservation form; Google listing open, 163 reviews.

LONG-STAY five tests (operator wording: 'While most campsites are permanent sites for seasonal trailers, we have many campsites for nightly, weekend, week-long stays'): (1) nightly rate posted - yes, $35-43 daily beside weekly; (2) booking channel - reservation form + phone, deposit/cancellation terms posted for short stays; (3) the campground page leads with 'Whether you are looking for seasonal, a week, weekend or just need a place to stop for the night, all are welcome', seasonal $2,100 offered below the daily table; (4) nightly share 50 of 250 = 20% ('250 campsites in total (200 permanent, 20 drive-through & 30 overnight)'), over 1 in 10; (5) no homes or lots for sale. Passes. I read it as MOSTLY SEASONAL (80% permanent), not iffy (dated-2026 rate page, 163 Google reviews, posted site counts); per the 10-50% nightly rule it stays with the seasonal caveat now in the note. No wording that discourages nightly guests.

PIN: stored 39.40529,-88.74249 is the IL-16 entrance (Google's point 39.40567,-88.74267); the site loops lie around the pool and pond to the north. Move to about 39.4092,-88.7458 (centre of the loops on Esri imagery; ~520 m from the stored pin).

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; agrees): the only water on site is the operator's '2.5 acre pond' (under 5 acres = a pond, no value); the 'Waterfront' names belong to the cabins on its east side. Lake Shelbyville is 2.5 miles away.

SEASON (derived 04-01..10-31 left alone): no page gives the campground's opening dates; only seasonal sites 'April through October' and cabin off-season rates 'April 1st-30th and end of Labor Day Weekend through October'.
